# `importConstellations()` {#fn-importconstellations}

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-importconstellations)

```{=html}
<p>Each non-comment line contains a unique figure identifier, the number
of segments, then two Hipparcos numbers per segment. Endpoints describe
separate pairs, not one continuous polygon. Blank lines and comments beginning
with a hash are ignored. Non-negative segment counts and positive integer HIP identifiers are validated.
Zero-segment records are retained with an empty HIP field and skipped when drawn.
Repeated endpoints represent a single-star figure, drawn as a small ring.
This supports Stellarium's legacy constellationship.fab format, not the JSON
sky-culture format introduced in Stellarium 25.1. Only lines are imported,
not artwork, labels, boundaries or star positions. Endpoint stars must be in
skyscapeR's stellar catalogue; unavailable stars produce warnings when drawn.
The import does not modify the bundled catalogue or register global names.
Save the returned object with saveRDS(), or load the file in each script.
Respect the source sky culture's attribution and redistribution terms.
</p>
```

<details><summary>Method references</summary>

```{=html}
<p>Stellarium User Guide, Adding Sky Cultures (legacy editions) and
Sky Cultures (current editions): <a href="https://stellarium.org/guide/">https://stellarium.org/guide/</a>.
Legacy example: <a href="https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium/blob/v0.22.2/skycultures/western/constellationship.fab">https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium/blob/v0.22.2/skycultures/western/constellationship.fab</a>.
</p>



```

</details>

**Interpretation and limits.** A drawn figure expresses a chosen connection between catalogue stars. Endpoints, projection and cultural attribution must be documented separately from any claim that the figure was visible together at a particular instant.


<details><summary>Implementation arguments, return value and documented modes</summary>

```{=html}
<table><thead><tr><th>Argument</th><th>Formal default</th><th>Behaviour in this interface</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th scope="row"><code>file</code></th><td>—</td><td><p>Path to a Stellarium legacy constellationship.fab text file.</p></td></tr><tr><th scope="row"><code>set</code></th><td><code>&quot;custom&quot;</code></td><td><p>Label for this collection, default "custom".</p></td></tr></tbody></table><h5>Return value</h5><p>A data frame with the same columns as <code>constellations</code>, accepted by
the <code>display$constellations</code> setting of <code>sketchSky</code> or the
<code>constellations</code> argument of <code>planisphere</code>. Subset rows to select individual figures.
</p>
```

</details>
